picks.editorial_note: A combined $1.175B commitment from Georgia Tech and Emory is one of the largest university AI investments to date, positioning the state as a national AI hub and signaling how deeply institutional capital is now flowing into AI infrastructure and research.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Emory Invest More Than $1B in AI to Drive State’s Jobs, Economic Growth

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced 15-university, 10-state computing consortium marks a major federal push to pool high-performance AI infrastructure regionally, reshaping how academic research access to compute is organized nationally.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: SLAC leading a DOE Genesis Mission project to apply autonomous AI discovery to catalysis research could accelerate breakthroughs in energy science, reflecting the federal government's strategic bet on AI-driven scientific discovery at national labs.
picks.title: SLAC to lead a Department of Energy Genesis Mission project for Super Intelligence (SI)-driven autonomous discovery in catalysis

picks.editorial_note: Phase II DOE funding for Berkeley Lab's AI-driven particle accelerator design project shows sustained federal investment in applying AI to fundamental physics infrastructure, with implications for future accelerator facilities nationwide.
picks.title: Super Intelligence for Particle Accelerators Gets Another Boost

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's SPIRE project to build autonomous 'self-driving laboratories' using AI agents and robots represents a significant step toward fully automated scientific experimentation at major research facilities.
picks.title: SLAC leads new project to build the self-driving laboratory of the future

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's two DOE Genesis Mission awards apply AI to microelectronics and quantum information science, advancing critical technologies at the intersection of AI and next-generation computing hardware.
picks.title: Fermilab to lead two new Genesis Mission awards to accelerate development of microelectronics and quantum

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's $20M NSF-funded Nexus supercomputer, opened to researchers nationwide in partnership with UIUC, expands shared national AI research infrastructure at a critical time of compute scarcity in academia.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Opens Supercomputer to Researchers Nationwide

picks.editorial_note: CMU's Ataraxos system, published in Nature, beating top human players at Stratego demonstrates real progress in AI reasoning under hidden information — a long-standing hard problem relevant to negotiation, security, and strategic decision-making applications.
picks.title: CMU Researchers Develop AI That Tackles Hidden Information in Stratego

picks.editorial_note: RobCo's billion-euro valuation as TUM's 24th unicorn highlights how academic robotics research is translating directly into commercially significant AI-driven industrial automation companies.
picks.title: RobCo: TUM’s 24th unicorn

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Phase 2 advancement of the UC-led MAESTRO project applies multi-agent AI to geothermal energy optimization, an example of AI directly accelerating clean energy research with near-term deployment potential.
picks.title: Department of Energy awards AI geothermal project to UCs
